title: Import-level closures select 9 scripts (525.7 s recorded) for a payload.py function-body edit none of them executes
claim: Of the 170 (script, D3-s2 cell) closure pairs whose traced unmutated run is clean, 29 claim a cell whose function bodies the script never executes and never reads as text, so closure.py select runs that script for any function-body-only edit of that cell although the edit cannot change its run; payload.py alone carries 525.7 s of 3051.3 s recorded selected seconds this way (boost_drift_replay.py 341.1 s, optimality.py 142.5 s, validate.py 21.5 s, guard_pins.py 8.2 s, manual_plan.py 6.5 s, ...).
mechanism: tests/closures.json records the files a run imported or opened (derive_closures.sh); a module imported for its constants or a type is a closure member even when no function of it runs. tests/mutation_table.py already exploits the finer fact (reach_skip / never_reaches) for mutants, but the scoped gate's selection does not.

evidence.unit: over-approximated (script, cell) pairs of 170 clean pairs
evidence.machine: box B2, 4 cores, shared with D0-s2 and D9-s2
evidence.contention_note: count from traced baselines (mutation_table.traced_baseline, run by prescreen.py); contention-immune; the seconds weights are tests/closures.json's recorded seconds, not measured here

instrumented_symbol: tests/mutation_table.py:traced_baseline/collect/reach_problems over tests/closures.json:closures (the selection tests/closure.py select reads)

perturbation.change: --claim-only tests/boost_drift_replay.py:payload.py (drop that pair from the closure the count reads, the effect of a body-granular closure for that pair)

metric_definition: pairs (script, cell) in closures.json with a clean traced baseline that executed zero function-body lines of the cell and did not read it as text
phenomenon_property: A scoped-gate selection should not run a script for an edit confined to function bodies that script's measured run never executes.
proposed_fix_scope: Measure only; a body-granular selection is a gate-design change (module-level edits must still select every importer). At most a closure.py selection refinement that skips a script for a function-body-only hunk in a file its recorded reach never executes, reusing mutation_table.never_reaches.
reproduction_steps: Run prescreen.py to produce run/reach/*.json (traced baselines)
